  - text: CLASS 11 · MATHEMATICAL INDUCTION
  - heading "Strong Induction Introduction" [level=1]
  - paragraph:
    - text: "Goal: Prove that every integer"
    - strong: n ≥ 8
    - text: can be written as a sum of 3-unit and 5-unit tiles.
  - main:
    - heading "SUPPORT-BLOCK PROOF LAB" [level=2]:
      - img
      - text: SUPPORT-BLOCK PROOF LAB
    - paragraph: We use strong induction, so we assume all cases up to k are true (multiple supports).
    - text: k =
    - spinbutton "Strong induction k": "13"
    - button "Reset proof":
      - img
      - text: Reset proof
    - separator
    - heading "BASE CASES (VERIFY)" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Check P(8), P(9), P(10) directly.
    - button "8 = 3 + 5 3 5 Verified":
      - strong: 8 = 3 + 5
      - text: 3 5
      - img
      - text: Verified
    - button "9 = 3 + 3 + 3 3 3 3 Verified":
      - strong: 9 = 3 + 3 + 3
      - text: 3 3 3
      - img
      - text: Verified
    - button "10 = 5 + 5 5 5 Verified":
      - strong: 10 = 5 + 5
      - text: 5 5
      - img
      - text: Verified
    - separator
    - heading "INDUCTION STEP (k + 1 ≥ 11)" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Assume P(8), P(9), ..., P(k) are true. Prove P(k + 1).
    - article:
      - paragraph: "STRONG HYPOTHESIS: We may use P(k - 2) because k - 2 ≥ 8."
      - strong: P(11) is true
      - text: ⇒ 11 can be written using 3s and 5s 5 3 3
    - article:
      - paragraph: "ADD ONE 3-TILE: Adding one 3-tile to the representation of k - 2 gives a representation of k + 1."
      - strong: 14 = 11 + 3
      - text: ⇒ P(14) is true 5 3 3 3
    - img
    - text: "Conclusion: By strong induction, every integer n ≥ 8 can be written as a sum of 3-unit and 5-unit tiles."
    - complementary:
      - 'button "STRONG INDUCTION ASSUMPTION (MULTIPLE SUPPORTS) Assume all cases up to k are true. Assumed true: P(8) P(9) P(10) ... P(k-2) P(k-1) P(k)"':
        - heading "STRONG INDUCTION ASSUMPTION (MULTIPLE SUPPORTS)" [level=2]
        - paragraph: Assume all cases up to k are true.
        - strong: "Assumed true:"
        - text: P(8) P(9) P(10) ... P(k-2) P(k-1) P(k)
      - 'button "ORDINARY INDUCTION (SINGLE SUPPORT) Assume only the single case P(k) is true. Assumed true: P(k)"':
        - heading "ORDINARY INDUCTION (SINGLE SUPPORT)" [level=2]
        - paragraph: Assume only the single case P(k) is true.
        - strong: "Assumed true:"
        - text: P(k)
      - article:
        - heading "DEFINITION (OUR STATEMENT)" [level=2]
        - paragraph: "P(n): Every integer n ≥ 8 can be written as a sum of 3-unit and 5-unit tiles."
      - article:
        - heading "TILE LEGEND" [level=2]
